text: Tesla's Gigafactory Nevada, located outside Reno, is the world's largest lithium-ion battery plant. Panasonic manufactures battery cells at the facility under a joint venture agreement signed in 2014. The factory produces battery packs for the Tesla Model 3 and Tesla Model Y, both of which are assembled at Tesla's Fremont factory in California. Tesla's Autopilot system, a Level 2 driver-assistance feature, uses neural networks trained on data collected from the fleet. Mobileye, an Intel subsidiary, previously supplied the vision processing chips before Tesla developed its own Full Self-Driving computer. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has investigated multiple crashes involving Autopilot, issuing recalls in 2023 and 2024.
